titleCard.headline: 菜单意图预测
titleCard.lede: 根据指针轨迹，判断你是不是要进子菜单。
points: 斜着过去时，途中的项不要抢走子菜单

closeCard.headline: 说清楚
points: 上一帧指针和子菜单左缘围成走廊
走廊内不切换 || 纵向立刻切
顶点是上一帧，不是当前指针

titleCard.headline: Menu intent
titleCard.lede: Guess from the pointer path whether you are heading into the submenu.
points: On a diagonal, passing items must not steal the submenu

closeCard.headline: Say it this way
points: Previous pointer and the leading edge form a corridor
Stay inside, do not switch || Vertical moves switch now
Past the leading edge, protection ends
The vertex is the previous sample, not the live pointer

lines.zh: 菜单意图预测。根据指针轨迹，判断你是不是要进子菜单。
lines.en: Menu intent prediction. From the pointer path, guess whether you are heading into the submenu.

lines.zh: 从一级斜着滑向二级时，指针会短暂经过中间其它项。若悬停到谁就展开谁，子菜单会被途中抢走。
lines.en: Sliding diagonally from the first column into the second briefly crosses other items. If whichever item you hover opens, the submenu gets stolen mid-path.

lines.zh: 子菜单打开后，用上一帧指针和子菜单左缘上下两点，构成一条安全走廊。斜向穿越时，只要还在走廊里，途经的项不会抢走子菜单。
lines.en: After the submenu opens, the previous pointer sample and the leading-edge corners form a safe corridor. Stay inside on a diagonal, and passing items will not steal the submenu.

lines.zh: 沿一级列表上下移动、轨迹不朝向子菜单，则立刻切换。意图预测只保护像是要进去的那条斜线。
lines.en: Moving up and down the first column, not toward the submenu, switches immediately. Intent only protects a path that looks like it is going in.

lines.zh: 打开项目属性，再进项目标签，再斜向进入紧急。每一级都有自己的安全三角。进入子菜单后，走廊变绿。
lines.en: Open Project, then Project tags, then slide into Urgent. Each level has its own safe triangle. It turns green after you enter the submenu.

lines.zh: 指针越过子菜单左缘之后，走廊结束，也不再画反向三角。和一律加延迟不同：纵向扫不发黏，斜向才保护。
lines.en: Once the pointer crosses the submenu's leading edge, the corridor ends, and we do not draw a reverse triangle. Unlike a flat delay: vertical scans stay snappy, diagonals stay protected.
